Friendzy / Classic party games / Pattern Recognition

How to play Pattern Recognition

Make a pattern. Can the group crack it? One player secretly creates a pattern rule and performs a sequence. Others have to figure out the rule and join in correctly. Great for groups who love puzzles.

3–10 players~8 minObservant & CleverMemory & chain games🚗 Works in the car

How to play

  1. One player secretly decides on a rule (e.g., 'every third word I say is a color').
  2. They perform or speak naturally, following their hidden rule.
  3. Others observe and try to guess what the rule is.
  4. When you think you know, try to participate and follow the rule yourself.
  5. The player with the rule confirms if you got it right.

Example round

  • Rule: 'I clap after any word with more than 4 letters.' Others watch and try to clap at the right moments.
  • Rule: 'Every time I start a sentence, I touch my nose first.' Subtle. Takes a while to notice.
  • Rule: 'I only make eye contact when saying a lie.' Gets intense fast.

Tips

  • Start with obvious patterns to teach the format, then get sneaky.
  • Body language rules are harder to spot than verbal ones.
